knowledge:
- key_parameters: bam_file=Path to a .bam file used to read sequence names, lengths, or coverage data ;; fasta_file=Path to a single .fasta file used to read sequence names and lengths ;; wanted_chr=Character vector of specific chromosomes to keep when reading ideogram data ;; unwanted_chr=Character vector of specific chromosomes to exclude when reading ideogram data ;; just_pattern=Regex pattern to filter sequence names when reading ideogram data ;; window_size=Window size (in bp) over which coverage is calculated; larger values speed up reading and plotting ;; smoothing_window_size=Window size for moving average smoothing of coverage data to reduce visual noise ;; either_side=Controls target sequence padding around insertion sites; can be "default", a bp number, a start/end vector, or a GRanges ;; style=Integer (1 to 4) controlling relative sizes and styles of target vs. inserted sequences in insertion diagrams ;; feature_label_cutoff=Threshold size (in bp) below which feature labels are drawn outside the feature to prevent overlap ;; custom_sector_width=Numeric vector to manually specify the relative width/size of each sector ;; zoom_sectors=Character vector of sectors to zoom in on during initialization ;; zoom_prefix=Prefix added to the labels of zoomed sectors
- alternatives: circlize=The underlying circular plotting engine; raw circlize functions (e.g., circos.text, circos.rect) can be used to add custom annotations to gmoviz plots ;; ComplexHeatmap=The underlying engine for legends; gmoviz provides the simplified wrapper makeLegends
- when_to_use: Use when characterizing genetically modified organisms or edited cell lines to visualize tandem integration events, complex constructs, plasmids, or structural variations alongside coverage and feature annotations.
- pitfalls: Sequence names in regions_of_interest must match the BAM file exactly (e.g., "chr4" vs "4" or "Chr4" will throw an error) ;; Plotting more than 10,000-15,000 coverage points without a larger window_size will take a very long time to plot ;; getIdeogramData filters (wanted_chr, unwanted_chr, just_pattern) only work on bam_file and fasta_folder inputs, not on a single fasta_file ;; Adding multiple insertion sites across different chromosomes using insertionDiagram is not supported; use multipleInsertionDiagram instead ;; When using multipleInsertionDiagram, either_side and style must be specified using event names, not chromosome names ;; If you want to use circlize to generate a new plot after using gmoviz, you must call circos.clear() to reset ;; For line graphs (drawLinegraphTrack), data must be sorted in ascending order before plotting

workflows.name: single_insertion_diagram
workflows.intent: Plot a single or tandem insertion event on a target sequence with optional coverage and label annotations.
input: insertion_data.gff (or GRanges/data.frame containing insertion site, name, length, and optional tandem copy number)
coverage.bam (optional BAM file for target sequence coverage)
labels.gff3 (optional GFF file for nearby gene/exon labels)
workflows.stages: 1. Define insertion data ;; 2. Define nearby labels and coverage data ;; 3. Generate the insertion diagram with customized styles, coverage, and labels
workflows.code:
example_insertion <- GRanges(seqnames = "chr12",
                      ranges = IRanges(start = 70905597, end = 70917885),
                      name = "plasmid", colour = "#7270ea", length = 12000,
                      in_tandem = 11, shape = "forward_arrow")
insertionDiagram(insertion_data = example_insertion, 
                 space_between_sectors = 20, xaxis_spacing = 45)

insertionDiagram(example_insertion, space_between_sectors = 20, style = 2)

single_copy_insertion <- GRanges(seqnames = "chr12",
                       ranges = IRanges(start = 70905597, end = 70917885),
                       name = "plasmid", length = 12000)
insertionDiagram(single_copy_insertion, space_between_sectors = 20, style = 3)
insertionDiagram(single_copy_insertion, space_between_sectors = 20, style = 4)

multi_insertions <- GRanges(seqnames = "chr12",
                       ranges = IRanges(start = 70910000, end = 70920000),
                       name = "plasmid2", length = 10000)
multiple_insertions <- c(single_copy_insertion, multi_insertions)

insertionDiagram(multiple_insertions)

nearby_genes <- GRanges(seqnames = c("chr12", "chr12"),
                        ranges = IRanges(start = c(70901000, 70911741),
                                         end = c(70910000, 70919000)),
                        label = c("Gene A", "Gene B"))
insertionDiagram(insertion_data = example_insertion, 
                 label_data = nearby_genes,
                 either_side = nearby_genes, 
                 space_between_sectors = 20,
                 xaxis_spacing = 75, # one x axis label per 75 degrees
                 label_size = 0.8, # smaller labels so they fit
                 track_height = 0.1) # smaller shapes so the labels fit

coverage <- GRanges(seqnames = rep("chr12", 400),
                    ranges = IRanges(start = seq(from = 70901000, 
                                                 to = 70918955, by = 45),
                                     end = seq(from = 70901045, 
                                               to = 70919000, by = 45)),
                    coverage = c(runif(210, 10, 15), rep(0, 190)))

insertionDiagram(insertion_data = example_insertion, 
                 coverage_data = coverage,
                 coverage_rectangle = "chr12",
                 either_side = nearby_genes, 
                 space_between_sectors = 20,
                 xaxis_spacing = 75) # one x axis label per 75 degrees

insertionDiagram(example_insertion, start_degree = 45, 
                 space_between_sectors = 20)

insertionDiagram(example_insertion, either_side = 10000, start_degree = 45,
                 space_between_sectors = 20)

insertionDiagram(example_insertion, either_side = c(70855503, 71398284),
start_degree = 45, space_between_sectors = 20)

workflows.name: multiple_insertion_diagram
workflows.intent: Display multiple insertion events across different chromosomes in a genome using a multi-circle layout.
input: insertion_data.gff (or GRanges/data.frame containing multiple insertion sites)
genome_ideogram.gff (or GRanges/data.frame containing chromosome names and lengths)
workflows.stages: 1. Define genome ideogram and insertion data ;; 2. Define optional coverage and label data ;; 3. Generate the multiple insertion diagram with customized styles and padding
workflows.code:
ideogram_data <- GRanges(
  seqnames = paste0("chr", 1:6), 
  ranges = IRanges(start = rep(0, 6), end = rep(12000, 6)))
insertion_data <- GRanges(
  seqnames = c("chr1", "chr5"),
  ranges = IRanges(start = c(4000, 2000), end = c(4100, 2200)),
  name = c("ins1", "ins5"), length = c(100, 200))
multipleInsertionDiagram(insertion_data = insertion_data,
                         genome_ideogram_data = ideogram_data,
                         colour_set = rich_colours)

example_coverage <- GRanges(
seqnames = c(rep("chr1", 100), rep("chr5", 100)),
ranges = IRanges(start = c(seq(3985, 4114, length.out = 100),
                           seq(1970, 2229, length.out = 100)),
                 end = c(seq(3986, 4115, length.out = 100),
                         seq(1971, 2230, length.out = 100))),
                 coverage = c(runif(100, 0, 25), runif(100, 0, 15)))

 example_labels <- GRanges(seqnames = c("chr1", "chr5"),
                           ranges = IRanges(start = c(4000, 2000),
                           end = c(4120, 2200)),
                           label = c("Gene A", "Gene B"),
                           colour = c("red", "blue"))

multipleInsertionDiagram(insertion_data = insertion_data,
                         genome_ideogram_data = ideogram_data,
                         coverage_rectangle = c("chr1", "chr5"),
                         coverage_data = example_coverage,
                         label_data = example_labels, 
                         label_colour = example_labels$colour)

multipleInsertionDiagram(insertion_data = insertion_data,
                         genome_ideogram_data = ideogram_data,
                         either_side = 1000, style = 2)

either_side_GRange <- GRanges("chr5", IRanges(1000, 3200))
multipleInsertionDiagram(insertion_data = insertion_data,
                         genome_ideogram_data = ideogram_data,
                         either_side = list("ins1" = 1000, 
                                            "ins5" = either_side_GRange),
                         style = c("ins1" = 2, "ins5" = 4))

workflows.name: feature_diagram
workflows.intent: Display general genomic features (such as genes, exons, plasmids, or complex constructs) as color-coded shapes on a circular plot.
input: ideogram_data.gff (or GRanges/data.frame containing sequence names and lengths)
workflows.stages: 1. Read features from GFF file ;; 2. Define ideogram and optional coverage data ;; 3. Generate the feature diagram with customized tracks, shapes, and optional links
workflows.code:
plasmid_ideogram <- GRanges("plasmid", IRanges(start = 0, end = 3000))
plasmid_features <- getFeatures(
  gff_file = system.file("extdata", "plasmid.gff3", package="gmoviz"),
  colour_by_type = FALSE, # colour by name rather than type of feature
  colours = rich_colours) # choose colours from rich_colours (see ?colourSets)

featureDiagram(plasmid_ideogram, plasmid_features, track_height = 0.17,
               label_track_height = 0.11, 
               space_between_sectors = 0, # continuous circle
               xaxis_spacing = 30, # x axis label every 30 degrees
               start_degree = 90) # start from 90 degrees (12 o'clock)

coverage <- GRanges(seqnames = rep("plasmid", 200),
                    ranges = IRanges(start = seq(from = 0, to = 2985, by = 15),
                                     end = seq(from = 15, to = 3000, by = 15)),
                    coverage = c(runif(110, 10, 15), rep(0, 90)))

featureDiagram(plasmid_ideogram, plasmid_features, track_height = 0.17,
               coverage_rectangle = "plasmid", # don't forget this!
               coverage_data = coverage, 
               label_track_height = 0.11, space_between_sectors = 0, 
               xaxis_spacing = 30, start_degree = 90)

complex_ideogram <- GRanges(seqnames = c("Gene X", "Template"),
                            ranges = IRanges(start = c(5000, 0), 
                                             end = c(6305, 3788)))

exon_label <- GRanges("Gene X", IRanges(5500, 5960), label = "Exon 2")
  
complex_features <- getFeatures(
  gff_file = system.file("extdata", "complex_insertion.gff3", 
                         package="gmoviz"),
  colours = rich_colours)

complex_features$track[c(3,4)] <- 2 # cut sites on the next track in
complex_features$shape[c(3,4)] <- "upwards_triangle" # triangles 

featureDiagram(ideogram_data = complex_ideogram, 
               feature_data = complex_features, 
               label_data = exon_label, custom_sector_width = c(0.6, 0.4),
               sector_colours = c("#6fc194", "#84c6d6"),
               sector_border_colours = c("#599c77", "#84c6d6"),
               space_between_sectors = 25, start_degree = 184, 
               label_size = 1.1)

link <- data.frame(chr = c("Gene X", "Template"),
                   start = c(5600, 0),
                   end = c(5706, 3788))
featureDiagram(ideogram_data = complex_ideogram, 
               feature_data = complex_features, label_data = exon_label, 
               custom_sector_width = c(0.6, 0.4),
               sector_colours = c("#6fc194", "#84c6d6"),
               sector_border_colours = c("#599c77", "#84c6d6"),
               space_between_sectors = 25, start_degree = 184, 
               label_size = 1.1, link_data = link)

workflows.name: incremental_plotting
workflows.intent: Build a highly customized circular plot track-by-track, combining features, scatterplots, line graphs, and legends.
input: coverage.bam (BAM file for ideogram and coverage)
workflows.stages: 1. Read ideogram, coverage, labels, and features from files ;; 2. Generate numeric data ;; 3. Create legend objects ;; 4. Initialize the plot and draw tracks incrementally inside gmovizPlot
workflows.code:
library(pasillaBamSubset)
fly_ideogram_chr4_only <- getIdeogramData(
  fasta_file = pasillaBamSubset::dm3_chr4())

chr4_coverage <- getCoverage(
  regions_of_interest = "chr4", 
  bam_file = pasillaBamSubset::untreated3_chr4(),
  window_size = 350, smoothing_window_size = 400)

labels_from_file <- getLabels(
  gff_file = system.file("extdata", "example.gff3", package = "gmoviz"),
  colour_code = TRUE)

features <- getFeatures(
  gff_file = system.file("extdata", "example.gff3", package = "gmoviz"), 
  colours = gmoviz::rich_colours)

numeric_data <- GRanges(seqnames = rep("chr4", 50),
                       ranges = IRanges(start = sample(0:1320000, 50),
                                        width = 1),
                       value = runif(50, 0, 25))

legend <- makeLegends(
    feature_legend = TRUE, feature_data = features, 
    feature_legend_title = "Regions of interest", scatterplot_legend = TRUE,
    scatterplot_legend_title = "Numeric data", 
    scatterplot_legend_labels = "value")

gmovizPlot(file_name = "example.svg", file_type = "svg", 
           plotting_functions = {
    gmovizInitialise(
        fly_ideogram_chr4_only, space_between_sectors = 25, start_degree = 78,
        xaxis_spacing = 30, sector_label_size = 1)
    drawScatterplotTrack(
        numeric_data, track_height = 0.14, yaxis_increment = 12)
    drawFeatureTrack(
        features, feature_label_cutoff = 80000, track_height = 0.15)
}, legends = legend, title = "Chromosome 4", background_colour = "white",
width = 8, height = 5.33, units = "in")
